steps.arg:
"cat > work/calibrate.py <<'PY'
import numpy as np, cv2,json
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
# intersections of straight sections of the rounded chrome structure
image=np.array([[90,43],[285,13],[212,112],[448,59],[110,223],[282,171],[213,336],[415,243]],float)

def coords(p):
 w=3.8; d,h=p[:2]
 return np.array([[-w/2,d/2,h],[w/2,d/2,h],[-w/2,-d/2,h],[w/2,-d/2,h],[-w/2,d/2,0],[w/2,d/2,0],[-w/2,-d/2,0],[w/2,-d/2,0]],float)
def project(p):
 K=np.array([[p[2],0,240],[0,p[2],180],[0,0,1.]])
 return cv2.projectPoints(coords(p),p[3:6],p[6:9],K,None)[0][:,0]
p=np.array([2.5,3.4,750, 1.9,-.7,.4, 0,0,13.])
# initialize rvec with actual look-at orientation
loc=np.array([-6.,-10.,7.]); target=np.array([0,0,1.2]); f=(target-loc);f/=np.linalg.norm(f);r=np.cross(f,[0,0,1]);r/=np.linalg.norm(r);down=np.cross(f,r)
R=np.array([r,down,f]); p[3:6]=cv2.Rodrigues(R)[0][:,0];p[6:9]=-R@loc
res=least_squares(lambda q:(project(q)-image).ravel(),p,max_nfev=3000)
p=res.x
print('parameters',p,'cost',res.cost); print(project(p));R=cv2.Rodrigues(p[3:6])[0];loc=-R.T@p[6:9]
print('location',loc,'R',R)
json.dump(dict(depth=p[0],height=p[1],focal=p[2],camera=loc.tolist(),R=R.tolist(),width=3.8),open('work/camera.json','w'),indent=2)
